input_policy: Original raw C1, no intensity rewriting or spatial resampling; preserve baseline full-field Nellie broad.

strong_signal_rule.reference_pixels: All finite positive original pixels in full frame; independent of ROI, Nellie labels and C2.
strong_signal_rule.undefined_policy: Stop this isolated test and report frame if insufficient valid pixels or scale<=0; no silent threshold substitution.
strong_signal_rule.interpretation: A conservative robust intensity margin; not pure background/camera noise, no6sigma confidence/false-positive claim.

union_stage: Per original frame, default broad OR strong raw-C1 pixels, before50-frame support counting.

diagnostics.bright_region: Original block-first C1 > saved original full-frame P99 then restricted to unchanged ROI; same region for all methods; diagnostic not accuracy.
diagnostics.detail_display: Shared non-saturating high-intensity display for three block-first frames; display only, not segmentation input.
